_doc: V2 narration (English) for both cuts. Same claims and qualifiers as v1 (voScript.json). 'cap' = on-screen caption, 'tts' = what the voice reads (risky tokens spelled out). Phrase punctuation (, . ? : …) must match between cap and tts. Every number must exist in verifiedClaims.ts (tests/factualChecks.ts).

master.cap: Meet Kimi K3.1 Pro, the new open-weight model from Moonshot AI.
master.tts: Meet Kimi K three point one Pro, the new open-weight model from Moonshot AI.

master.cap: It's a 3-trillion-parameter class model, with a 1-million-token context window. Room for bigger projects, with more context.
master.tts: It's a three-trillion-parameter class model, with a one-million-token context window. Room for bigger projects, with more context.

master.cap: In coding, it goes from quick fixes to full-project builds. Front-end pages, interactive Three.js scenes, and complete experiences with game engines like Unity, Unreal and Godot.
master.tts: In coding, it goes from quick fixes to full-project builds. Front-end pages, interactive Three J S scenes, and complete experiences with game engines like Unity, Unreal and Godot.

master.cap: It's strong in 3D, too. From a text brief, a sketch or a reference image, it builds parametric, CAD-style models. On BenchCAD with tools: 92.7 percent, close to the top models.

master.cap: In one internal test, it built a human walking simulator. 167 missions, 420 reviews, 36 shoulder-muscle calculation errors fixed… and a simulated human that went from falling over to 11.2 seconds of continuous walking.
